page.content:
Diver, filmmaker, and co-inventor of the Aqua-Lung who popularized the sea.

How Jacques Cousteau connects

  • Ship: Calypso — Cousteau filmed and dived from the Calypso.
  • Item: Aqua-Lung — Cousteau co-invented the Aqua-Lung with Émile Gagnan.
  • Topic: Oceanography — Cousteau made ocean life a public subject beyond the research fleet.
  • Ship: Calypso — Calypso produced the films that made Cousteau's ocean public.

What is Jacques Cousteau?

Jacques-Yves Cousteau took scuba and the Calypso into living rooms, making mid-century oceanography a public story as well as a shipboard science.

Key threads lead to Calypso, Aqua-Lung, Oceanography and Calypso.
